$comment: EDIT THIS FILE to add pages to the audit, then run `pnpm capture`.
Each target becomes one Storybook page under Journeys/<journey>/<title>.
url    — direct URL to capture. Leave as null for pages you can't reach yet;
they render in Storybook as 'Pending capture' placeholders.
flow   — OPTIONAL. If set, the scraper starts at flow.start and performs
flow.steps to reach the page (for order-bound pages whose URL is
ephemeral). Used only when `url` is null.
(a Playwright storageState) so cookie-gated pages work.
order  — sort position within the journey.
